description: Append markdown to an existing document. expected_version optional; omitted or 0 resolves the current version. Catalog metadata (tags, importance, title, type) carries over; change it via mark_publish. route=today: url is a directory, the entry goes to its journal/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md (created when absent, hubs linked, tags widened; an archived scope refuses); a repeated entry is reported present, not written. Requires -token.

expected_version.description: version from prior fetch; omit or 0 to auto-resolve

route.description: today: url names a directory and the entry lands in its dated journal

tags.description: with route=today: comma-separated subjects of the entry, added to the journal's tags

name: mark_append

description: Archive a document: fetches as 'archived', history kept. recursive=true: url is a directory, every live document under it. Ancestor hubs drop the bullets that only linked what was archived. Requires -token.

recursive.description: archive every live document under the directory url (default false)

name: mark_archive

description: Documents linking to a URL, from the revision-aware graph store, with bounded source revalidation. Freshness, provenance and typed relations also appear in mark_explore.
name: mark_backlinks

description: Bring one document into shape: style findings, a proposed mechanical fix (an edit, or at 8KB a split into a hub plus topic files with anchors kept), inbound links to repoint, a proposal hash. A directory url (trailing /) proposes mark_doctor's fixable findings under it, up to 100 writes. apply=true with the hash writes it at the reported versions. Writes require -token.

apply.description: write the proposal (default false: report only)

proposal.description: the proposal hash from the report; required with apply

name: mark_curate

description: Fetch the agent manifest (/.well-known/agent-manifest.md): purpose, key paths, auth, usage. not-found if absent.
name: mark_discover

description: Read-only hygiene audit of a store or directory: broken links, orphans, missing hubs, untagged or untyped documents, write-policy compliance under the floor (axes, fields, allowed values), secrets and personal data, duplicates, hub and document shape, style, a stale style guide, ADR gaps. Bounded; Coverage lists gaps. deep: metadata lost across versions. promotion: candidates for a shared knowledge system.

deep.description: walk version history for lost metadata (default false)

promotion.description: list promotion candidates, promoted ones excluded (default false)

url.description: mark:// URL of the store root or a directory, e.g. mark://host/demarkus/

name: mark_doctor

description: Orient around one document: outline, outbound links, backlinks, siblings (10 each). Relation query arguments request grouped, paginated neighborhoods.

cursor.description: continuation cursor from the prior result

relations.description: relation predicates to include; empty string is body links; omit for all

name: mark_explore

description: Fetch a document: status, version, title, markdown body; over 8KB an outline (headings with #anchors), url#<anchor> one section, force=true the full body. Unchanged re-fetch returns a short notice. <dir>/.context reads a session primer: hub, newest journal entries, active work.

force.description: full body regardless of size or unchanged status (default false)

url.description: mark:// URL, e.g. mark://host/index.md; #<anchor> for one section

name: mark_fetch

description: Crawl outbound links from a document to depth: link graph with edge provenance and rel-* typed relations. External links recorded, not followed. Feeds the graph store for mark_backlinks.
name: mark_graph

description: Export the graph store as publishable markdown with mark:// links. Run mark_graph first.
name: mark_graph_export

description: Export the graph store and publish it as crawlable markdown (mark_graph_export + mark_publish). Run mark_graph first. Requires -token.

expected_version.description: version from prior fetch; 0 to create

retention.description: graph versions to keep (default 20; 0 keeps all); older permanently pruned

name: mark_graph_publish

description: List documents and subdirectories; an adr/ directory's first page adds next:, the unused decision number. Archived hidden unless include_archived; while complete=false pass next-cursor as cursor. For one document prefer mark_explore.

cursor.description: continuation cursor from the prior result

include_archived.description: include archived documents and all-archived directories (default false)

name: mark_list

description: Catalog lookup by subject: matches tags and title; match=body also matches section text. Importance-ranked table (path, importance, title, tags; body rows add #anchor and a snippet). budget>0 appends sections.

budget.description: result tokens for the whole result: matched sections follow the table in rank order, then related documents of the strongest match, under '>>> path/vN#anchor' lines, whole sections, until spent (default 0: table only)

filter.description: comma-separated key=value predicates: tag=, modified-after=, modified-before=

query.description: subject matched against tags and titles (min 2 chars); '*' for all

url.description: scope: / or a subtree; mark:// URL, e.g. mark://host/index.md

verbose.description: full tag lists per row (default false)

name: mark_lookup

description: Promote a document to a shared knowledge system, by phase. A write needs the packet from the report before it. Writes require -token.

body.description: dry_run, apply: the distilled draft; refresh: the live knowledge body, or omitted with a directory url to list its promoted documents

metadata.description: dry_run, apply: the draft's metadata object (tags, importance, type, the policy's axes)

packet.description: apply, stamp, refresh: the packet hash from the report before it

source.description: dry_run, apply: origin recorded as promoted-from (default none)

stub.description: stamp: reduce the body to its title and summary (default false: keep it)

target.description: stamp, refresh: the knowledge copy as <url>@v<N>

via.description: stamp: the knowledge server's name, recorded as promoted-via

name: mark_promote

description: Publish or update a document (markdown body); expected_version from prior fetch, 0 to create; metadata replaces the current map; a first version is linked from its hub (hubs:); a note lists dropped tags or keys, style problems, a hub not linked. On conflict the default on_conflict=merge returns a merged candidate body (git-style markers where both sides changed) to review and republish at publish-at-version. Requires -token.

expected_version.description: version from prior fetch; 0 to create

metadata.description: string values stored with the document: tags (comma-separated) and importance (0-1) rank mark_lookup; rel-<predicate> declares a typed relation (e.g. rel-supersedes: /adr/0002.md); other keys stored opaquely. retention (positive int) permanently deletes all but the newest N versions on this and every later write carrying it: irreversible, confirm with the user first

on_conflict.description: merge (default): merged candidate body to review and republish at publish-at-version; fail: raw conflict status

name: mark_publish

description: Version history: total and current version, hash chain validity, per-version timestamps.
name: mark_versions
